production_plan.throughput_basis: Production workcells use two 8-hour shifts each production day; civil activity uses two 8-hour shifts with calendar duration calculated from per-shift crew productivity; operations cost two shifts at 16/18-hour coverage in low/base and three shifts at 24-hour high case. Service train-km use two directional loops once, separate from the two physical corridor trackways. Shift premiums, utilisation and relief are explicit Class C assumptions.
